biological_rule: Simultaneous untreated de-novo EGFR and KRAS driver alterations are extremely rare (<0.2%).
Concomitant EGFR and ALK driver rearrangements occur in <0.5% of cases.
Frequent co-alteration; correlated with shorter duration of response to EGFR TKIs.
Predictor of primary resistance to single-agent immune checkpoint blockade.
Mutually exclusive MAPK pathway activation in melanoma baseline.
T790M emerges predominantly in cis with sensitizing Exon 19 del or L858R.
C797S emerges under osimertinib pressure in T790M-positive tumors.
